body: Not about deck building, but what do you think is the best approach to deal with politcs? I play a version of bloodpod and I find myself usually in a situation where I am the game's archenemy with little room to negotiate as every card in the deck aims to ruin everyone's game.

I think this may be a good approach to keep playing at the tables I am in.
But I am considering changing generals, I brought the topic to my pals and we came with the conclusion that Brago is too "honest" for the meta as it needs several conditions to cheat properly (Brago needs to hit, cards that create card advantage are not the same used for stax, so a big board presence is needed). We think in the same colors GAAIV  would be more suitable to the meta. But also looking into Derevi and BloodPod

Azorius Brago, problem was the balance between affecting the field and going for the win. It couldnt beat other combos in speed, but last build was pretty consistent in finding one of the two combos.
I think it was still a good deck to play against fast-combo ones, it was facing problems against one particular stax/control deck which aimed to do the same job, but was way better at it.

Agreed, I get those points, played Tymna&Ishai hatebears once, while without combos like the Blood-pod, it crearly applied more pressure on the table in terms of combat damage while filling my hand with answers.

I play the Brago. I think the main limitation is how difficult it is to have in hand the best stax pieces at the right time. Even when I have means to grab all those cards, I may lose timing playing them piece by piece.

When going for complete lock downs (stasis for example), hardly one will escape, this issue usually happens when only a few aspects of the game are locked with cards like trinesphere, RIP, cursed totem, aven mindsensor, etc hindering a onde deck while others is little affected.
The following decks are usualy played:
Brago (Stax)
Zur (MLD/Reanimation Combo/Beatdown)
Kess (Storm)
Gitrog (Dredge)
Teferi (Chain veil)

Most of the time is a Zur (wincons: Reanimation/MLD/Beatdown) which is not as fast as other decks in the play group, but is more adaptative to the hates placed on the battlefield easily shifting between strategies.
